info.title: Livepeer Valuation API
info.description: HTTP API for indexed Livepeer protocol events, valuation outcomes, token prices, stake snapshots, governance views, and transcoder context. The API is backed by deterministic replayable Postgres state derived from Arbitrum and Ethereum RPC inputs.

AggregationsQuery.description: Query model for time-bucketed event counts and value aggregations.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD or block number. Both endpoints accept both forms.

metric.description: One of: count, sum_amount_native, sum_amount_usd, avg_amount_usd

tz.description: IANA tz; default UTC. Controls bucket-edge alignment via date_trunc.

AggregationsResponse.description: Aggregation response over canonical indexed events.

source.description:
Source the response was served from: "rollup" (event_metrics_daily,
fast path) or "raw_events" (per-event scan, used when filters can't
be answered from the daily rollup).

BucketRow.description: One bucket in the aggregation result set.

CutsHistoryPoint.description: One TranscoderUpdate event for an orchestrator.

DelegationRow.description: One delegation held by a delegator (current state).

bonded_principal.description: Bonded principal (LPT) at the most recent observed block.

delegate_address.description: Address of the orchestrator the delegator is bonded to.

pending_stake.description:
Pending stake from BondingManager.pendingStake (LPT, may be null
if the staker pending-refresh worker hasn't observed this row yet).

DelegatorEventRow.description: One Bond/Unbond/Rebond/EarningsClaimed/etc. event involving the delegator.

amount_normalized.description: Normalized amount (decimal string in LPT or ETH).

asset.description:
Asset the event amount is denominated in (LPT for stake events,
ETH for fee events). Null for events without a value.

from_address.description:
The delegator's address from the event's perspective. Matches the
`address` path param when the delegator initiated the action; differs
when the delegator is the receiving party of a TransferBond.

side.description: Side the delegator was on for this event: `from`, `to`, or `both`.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 50, max 500).

DelegatorEventsResponse.description: Paginated activity timeline for a delegator.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for stable pagination by `(total_bonded DESC, delegator_address ASC)`.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 50, max 500).

DelegatorIndexResponse.description: Paginated index of delegators sorted by total bonded LPT.

DelegatorIndexRow.description: One delegator and their aggregate bonded total.

delegation_count.description: Count of delegations with non-zero bonded principal.

total_bonded.description: Sum of `bonded_principal` across all delegations the delegator currently holds.

DelegatorListResponse.description: Delegator distribution snapshot for a transcoder at a requested block.

DelegatorResponse.description: Delegator portfolio with one entry per delegation.

delegations.description:
Delegations the delegator currently holds. Ordered by
`bonded_principal DESC`.

is_active.description:
True if the delegator has at least one bonded delegation that has
not been fully unbonded.

DelegatorStakeRow.description: Point-in-time stake row for one delegator within a transcoder's delegator set.

ErrorBody.description: Structured contents of the API error response.

context.description: Optional structured debugging context. Present only when the server has extra details.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for operators and API consumers.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical JSON error envelope returned by failing API endpoints.

error.description: Standard top-level error wrapper returned by every failing API route.

EventListResponse.description: Paginated event list response with an opaque cursor and finality watermark.

ignored by `sort=amount_usd_desc`. Combine with `event_name` when a tx
emits multiple logs of different kinds.

NetEconomicsResponse.description: Aggregate revenue minus on-chain gas costs over a window.

gas_cost_native_eth.description:
Sum of tx fees (in native ETH) across all reward + redeem events
the orch was party to in the window. Currently captured for events
`to_address = orch` (Reward + WinningTicketRedeemed). Note that the
economic impact of gas falls on whoever paid the tx (often the
orch itself for Reward; the gateway for redeems).

gross_payouts_usd.description: Sum of orch_payouts_daily.sum_orch_value_usd across the period.

gross_rewards_usd.description: Sum of orch_rewards_daily.orch_lpt_rewards_usd across the period.

gross_total_usd.description:
Net = gross_payouts_usd + gross_rewards_usd. Gas cost is exposed
separately in native ETH; the API leaves USD conversion to the
caller (no token_prices_by_block lookup needed here).
